policy.severe_crop: Image boundary removes an eye or the mouth region; ordinary tight forehead/chin crops retained.
policy.extreme_profile: Head rotation hides one eye and much of the far side of the face; slight turns and borderline cases retained.

review_method: AI-assisted visual screening of all 20,716 images on 41 shuffled contact sheets; 4,415 candidates reviewed on 35 enlarged sheets; all proposed exclusions checked again. Class, split and model predictions hidden on review sheets. Saved visual decisions fix the exact package membership.
limitations: Subjective visual review at original 48x48 resolution; may miss cases. This is a geometry audit, not a complete content or expression-label audit. Unrelated content flags retained separately. No independent reviewer confirmation yet.
evaluation: No training or model inference performed. Previous metrics belong to the parent dataset. Evaluate any new model separately; do not transfer earlier results to this version.
verification: All retained image bytes match parent SHA256; original grayscale 48x48 images; one copy per decoded-pixel hash across all splits; file inventory and ZIP contents verified.
